<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1921407_nowflix.NowflixUtilsv2</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>NowflixUtilsv2</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var NowflixUtilsv2 = Class.create();
NowflixUtilsv2.prototype = {
	initialize: function () { },
	refQualMedia: function () {

		var moviesNotToBeShown = [];
		var grReview = new GlideRecord("x_1921407_nowflix_review");
		grReview.addEncodedQuery('opened_byDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe^state!=4');
		grReview.query();

		while (grReview.next()) {
			moviesNotToBeShown.push(grReview.media.sys_id.toString());
		}
		var moviesToBeShown = [];
		var grMedia = new GlideRecord('x_1921407_nowflix_media');
		grMedia.addQuery('state', '3');
		grMedia.query();

		while (grMedia.next()) {
			if (moviesNotToBeShown.indexOf(grMedia.getUniqueValue() == -1)) {
				moviesToBeShown.push(grMedia.getUniqueValue());
			}
		}
		return 'sys_idIN' + moviesToBeShown.join(',');
	},

	type: 'NowflixUtilsv2'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-22 18:30:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>4175e7dbc39803104a9d563ed40131fa</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>NowflixUtilsv2</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Nowflix" source="x_1921407_nowflix">bc71d55e838c4310ad5c9796feaad309</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Nowflix">bc71d55e838c4310ad5c9796feaad309</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_4175e7dbc39803104a9d563ed40131fa</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-22 18:45:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
